Example model

Install the extension and open a graph from the quickstart. Versions are in local setup. This page keeps the sample the repository test runs.

A small model to explore

import torch.nn as nn

# tensorviz: input=2,4
class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.hidden = nn.Linear(4, 8)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()
        self.output = nn.Linear(8, 2)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.output(self.relu(self.hidden(x)))

# tensorviz: input=2,4 belongs to the class it precedes. It is the example input when no tensorviz.toml profile and no single in-file example call supply one. Change inputs edits the saved setup. The other source directives are in the reference.
